prompt: elixir to_timeout Duration year month fields constraint
answer:
`to_timeout/1` requires a `Duration`’s `year` and `month` fields to be set to `0`. Durations containing nonzero years or months cannot be reliably converted to milliseconds because months and years have varying numbers of days.

`to_timeout/1` supports units only up to weeks: `:week`, `:day`, `:hour`, `:minute`, `:second`, and `:millisecond`. A nonzero `:year` or `:month` field raises an error.
